from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the provided collection, capturing its own title and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that are cited in this document's bibliography or text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
